# One World Labs

> One World Labs (oneworldlabs.ai) is an AI agency and app platform for small businesses and
> freelancers. Two divisions: The Agency — done-for-you AI services our team builds and runs —
> and The Platform — five apps that share one login (One ID).

## The Agency (done-for-you AI services)
- [OneVoice](https://onevoice.oneworldlabs.ai/): AI answering, scheduling & booking — an AI receptionist that answers every call 24/7, qualifies leads, and books appointments.
- [OnePage](https://onepage.oneworldlabs.ai/): AI websites — built with AI, then hosted, updated, and managed for the client.
- [OneApp](https://oneapp.oneworldlabs.ai/): a business's own mobile app, designed free, launched on the App Store and Google Play.
- Reputation & review management, Search & AI visibility (SEO + AI-assistant visibility), customer win-back campaigns, missed-call text-back, AI chat for web & social, marketing & follow-up automation, custom AI agents & integrations.
- Full menu: https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/services/

## The Platform (apps, one login)
- [OneJob](https://onejob.oneworldlabs.ai/): jobs marketplace — get hired and get paid, with verified reviews and contracts.
- [OneScore](https://onescore.oneworldlabs.ai/): a free, verified professional credibility score — like a credit score for your work reputation.
- [OneEvent](https://oneevent.oneworldlabs.ai/): create events, sell tickets, QR check-in.
- [OneSocial](https://onesocial.oneworldlabs.ai/): all your platforms, one professional identity.
- OneAgent: an AI workforce for professionals — coming soon.
- Overview: https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/
